categories.description: Waste that decomposes naturally, such as food scraps, vegetable peels, garden waste, and leftover food.
categories.recycle_details: Can be converted into compost through composting bins or vermicomposting. Not recyclable in the traditional sense but reusable as organic fertilizer.
recommendations: Use a separate compost bin at home
Avoid mixing with plastic or metal waste
Compost garden waste in a backyard pit

categories.description: Includes bottles, bags, packaging material, containers, and wrappers made of plastic.
categories.recycle_details: Recyclable plastics (marked with recycling codes 1-7) should be cleaned and sent to recycling centers. Single-use plastics should be minimized.
recommendations: Avoid single-use plastic bags and bottles
Rinse containers before disposal
Segregate by plastic type where possible
Switch to reusable alternatives like cloth bags

categories.description: Discarded electronic items such as old phones, batteries, chargers, computers, and appliances.
categories.recycle_details: Must be disposed of at authorized e-waste collection centers, never in regular trash, due to hazardous materials like lead and mercury.
recommendations: Never throw batteries or electronics in regular bins
Donate working electronics instead of discarding
Use certified e-waste recyclers
Remove personal data before disposal

categories.description: Includes newspapers, cardboard, office paper, books, and packaging paper.
categories.recycle_details: Highly recyclable. Clean, dry paper can be recycled into new paper products, cardboard, and packaging.
recommendations: Keep paper dry and free from food contamination
Flatten cardboard boxes before disposal
Reuse paper for notes before recycling
Avoid recycling paper with heavy plastic lamination

categories.description: Includes bottles, jars, and broken glassware.
categories.recycle_details: Glass is 100% recyclable and can be recycled endlessly without loss of quality. Should be separated by color where required.
recommendations: Rinse glass containers before disposal
Handle broken glass carefully and wrap before disposal
Reuse glass jars for storage when possible

categories.description: Includes cans, foil, scrap metal, and small appliances.
categories.recycle_details: Highly recyclable through scrap metal dealers and municipal recycling programs. Saves significant energy compared to new metal production.
recommendations: Flatten cans to save space
Separate metal from mixed waste
Sell scrap metal to authorized recyclers

categories.description: Includes chemicals, paints, pesticides, medical waste, and cleaning agents.
categories.recycle_details: Requires special handling and disposal through hazardous waste facilities. Should never be mixed with regular household waste.
recommendations: Store in original labeled containers
Never pour down drains or mix with regular trash
Use designated hazardous waste drop-off points
Keep away from children and pets
